translations.web: Others fell on rocky ground, where they didn’t have much soil, and immediately they sprang up, because they had no depth of earth.
translations.bsb: Some fell on rocky ground, where it did not have much soil. It sprang up quickly because the soil was shallow.
translations.kjv: Some fell upon stony places, where they had not much earth: and forthwith they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth:
translations.asv: and others fell upon the rocky places, where they had not much earth: and straightway they sprang up, because they had no deepness of earth:
